message.title: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge is presenting 3rd quarter 2026 accounts
message.body:
- Time: Friday 30 October at 09:30 CET
- Place: Livestream

The presentation will be held in Norwegian by group CEO Hanne Karoline Kræmer and CFO Bengt Olsen. Questions to the management in relation to the presentation can be sent to investor@snn.no. Questions will be read and answered on the livestream.

To request a digital meeting with the management after the presentation, please send an email to investor@snn.no by 29 October.

The link to the livestream will be made available at www.snn.no/investor. On the same website, you will also be able to download the presentation and the quarterly report on 30 October.

For further information, please contact:

- Terje Karlstad, Head of Investor Relations, terje.karlstad@snn.no, +47 411 22 220

This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to Section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
